name: BlockAt
lead: The block a hook was called about. Reads are fields and acts are methods. The reads are **live** — the world as it is right now — and everything that changes the world is carried out by the engine the moment the hook returns, in the order it was asked for.

functions.name: get
functions.description: The block one face away, by name; nil where that chunk is not in memory.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Puts another block at this position.

functions.name: become
functions.description: **The door**: this block stops being a block, and that entity appears.

functions.name: drop
functions.description: A name, or an item table: a pack item keeps its id.

functions.name: schedule
functions.description: Asks for this block's `on_tick`, `tick_every` seconds from now.

functions.name: notify
functions.description: Tells the six neighbours this block changed.

fields.name: data
fields.description: What this block remembers beyond its state; kept with the position, saved with the chunk, and gone when the block goes. Nested writes are tracked; whole-record assignment is supported. Copy before keeping it beyond the hook.

fields.name: at
fields.description: The block's position; a live read.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The block's name with its namespace, such as "rave:crate"; a live read.

fields.name: room
fields.description: Which room the block is in.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Which of this definition's states it is in, counting from 1. Writable, and bounds-checked against the definition's own `looks` list: it *is* the block state, so a crop's stages cost nothing.

fields.name: facing
fields.description: A facing block's front: "north", "south", "west", "east"; nil otherwise. Writable.

fields.name: powered
fields.description: Whether a redstone signal reaches it: what a lamp asks. A live read; nil where the chunk is not loaded.

title: BlockAt type
